# eon_restore_aws_security_groups (Data Source)

Lists AWS security groups available to a restore account in a region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_aws_security_groups" "example" {
  restore_account_id = "restore-account-id"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  vpc_id             = "vpc-example"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-example"
}

output "restore_aws_security_groups" {
  value = data.eon_restore_aws_security_groups.example.security_groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list security groups in.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.

### Optional

- `subnet_id` (String) Optionally filter security groups by subnet ID.
- `vpc_id` (String) Optionally filter security groups by VPC ID.

### Read-Only

- `security_groups` (Attributes List) Security groups available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) AWS security group ID.
- `name` (String) AWS security group name.
- `vpc` (String) AWS VPC ID containing the security group.
